result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is clipped to 'Tokumaru Ramer' due to collision with the rating, and right-edge carousel content is partially cut off.

issues.description: Restaurant title under 'Popular right now' is clipped and reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final 'n' cut off where the title meets the '4.8 (500+)' rating on the same line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the row layout with proper flex constraints, gap between title and rating, and correct text-overflow with ellipsis or wrapping so the full name is visible and does not collide with the rating.

issues.description: Right-edge content appears cut off: the far-right category pill is half-visible and the third 'Fastest near you' card shows as 'Trattoria Piccol' half off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing scroll padding and ensure carousel peek intent is clear so partial cut-off looks like intentional horizontal scroll rather than broken layout.
